SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN `paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2026-04-01' THEN `total_amount` + `freight_amount` END) AS `gmv_202603`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `paid_at` >= '2025-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2025-04-01' THEN `total_amount` + `freight_amount` END) AS `gmv_202503`,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN `paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2026-04-01' THEN `total_amount` + `freight_amount` END) - SUM(CASE WHEN `paid_at` >= '2025-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2025-04-01' THEN `total_amount` + `freight_amount` END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN `paid_at` >= '2025-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2025-04-01' THEN `total_amount` + `freight_amount` END), 0) AS `yoy_growth_rate`
FROM `trd_order`
WHERE (`paid_at` >= '2025-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2026-04-01') AND `paid_at` IS NOT NULL;
